item.title: MAC Minute — 2026-10-02
item.description:
Morning, MAC Fellas — quick one today. Flydubai Cargo unveils routes for freighter network launch. Worth watching for capacity and fleet. Silk Way West Orders Two Airbus A350F Freighters - safariindia.com. Worth watching for capacity and fleet. Ethiopian Airlines Places New Order for 10 Boeing 777F Jets - Aviation A2Z. Worth watching for capacity and fleet. That is the MAC minute. Have a good one.
